senses.sense_definition: Supersonic transport; a commercial aircraft designed to fly faster than the speed of sound.

examples.text: The retirement of the Concorde marked the end of commercial passenger flights on an <w>SST</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 协和式飞机的退役标志着商用<w>超音速客机</w>客运时代的终结。

examples.text: Several aerospace companies are developing a next-generation <w>SST</w> that produces a quieter sonic boom.

target_lang_translations.zh: 几家航空航天公司正在开发音爆更小的下一代<w>超音速客机</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 超音速客机；一种飞行速度超过音速的商用飞机。

senses.sense_definition: Sea surface temperature; the water temperature close to the surface of an ocean or sea.

examples.text: Satellite data revealed a dramatic increase in regional <w>SST</w> over the past decade.

target_lang_translations.zh: 卫星数据显示，过去十年该区域的<w>海表温度</w>显著上升。

examples.text: Meteorologists track changes in <w>SST</w> to predict the intensity and trajectory of tropical storms.

target_lang_translations.zh: 气象学家追踪<w>海面温度</w>的变化，以预测热带风暴的强度和路径。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 海表温度；海洋或海面附近表层的水温。

senses.sense_definition: Sales and service tax; a form of indirect tax charged on the sale of certain goods and services.

examples.text: Consumers noticed an increase in total receipt prices after the reintroduction of the <w>SST</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在重新引入<w>销售与服务税</w>后，消费者注意到账单总价有所上涨。

examples.text: Businesses must file periodic returns detailing the amount of <w>SST</w> collected.

target_lang_translations.zh: 企业必须定期提交报表，详细列出征收的<w>销售税与服务税</w>金额。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 销售与服务税；对某些商品销售和特定服务征收的一种间接税。

senses.sense_definition: Somatostatin; a peptide hormone that regulates the endocrine system and inhibits the secretion of several secondary hormones.

examples.text: Synthetic analogues of <w>SST</w> are frequently prescribed to manage specific neuroendocrine tumors.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>生长抑素</w>的人工合成类似物常用于治疗特定的神经内分泌肿瘤。

examples.text: The release of growth hormone is strongly suppressed in the presence of elevated <w>SST</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在<w>生长抑素</w>水平升高的情况下，生长激素的释放会受到强烈抑制。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 生长抑素；一种调节内分泌系统并抑制多种次级激素分泌的肽类激素。

senses.sense_definition: Single-session therapy; a clinical approach in psychotherapy where therapist and client aim to address an issue within a single meeting.

examples.text: The clinic introduced <w>SST</w> to reduce waiting times for patients seeking immediate psychological support.

target_lang_translations.zh: 该诊所引入了<w>单次咨询治疗</w>，以减少寻求即时心理支持患者的等待时间。

examples.text: Practitioners of <w>SST</w> focus intensively on practical strategies that clients can implement right away.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>单次治疗</w>的从业者高度聚焦于来访者能够立即付诸实践的实用策略。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 单次咨询治疗；心理治疗中的一种临床方法，治疗师与来访者旨在单次面谈中解决问题。

senses.sense_definition: Socioemotional selectivity theory; a life-span theory of motivation proposing that shrinking time horizons lead to prioritising emotionally meaningful goals.

examples.text: According to <w>SST</w>, older adults systematically narrow their social circles to focus on close relationships.

target_lang_translations.zh: 根据<w>社会情绪选择理论</w>，老年人会系统性地缩小社交圈，转而聚焦于亲密关系。

examples.text: The researcher applied principles from <w>SST</w> to explain variations in emotional wellbeing among retirees.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员应用<w>社会情绪选择理论</w>的原理来解释退休人员情绪幸福感的差异。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 社会情绪选择理论；一种毕生发展动机理论，认为感知到时间的缩短会促使人们优先关注具有情绪意义的目标。

senses.sense_definition: Spitzer Space Telescope; an infrared space observatory launched by NASA in 2003 and retired in 2020.

examples.text: Astronomers discovered numerous exoplanets using data collected by the <w>SST</w> during its extended mission.

target_lang_translations.zh: 天文学家利用<w>斯皮策空间望远镜</w>在延长任务期间收集的数据发现了许多系外行星。

examples.text: The infrared cameras on the <w>SST</w> allowed researchers to observe distant galaxies obscured by dust clouds.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>斯皮策太空望远镜</w>上的红外相机使研究人员能够观测到被尘埃云遮挡的遥远星系。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 斯皮策空间望远镜；由美国国家航空航天局（NASA）于2003年发射、2020年退役的红外空间天文台。

senses.sense_definition: Shiva Smart Tunneling; a proprietary computer networking protocol used for virtual private network connections.

examples.text: Legacy remote access systems often relied on <w>SST</w> to secure data transmissions over dial-up lines.

target_lang_translations.zh: 传统远程访问系统通常依靠<w>Shiva智能隧道协议</w>来保障拨号线路上的数据传输安全。

examples.text: Network engineers eventually phased out <w>SST</w> in favor of standardized IPSec and TLS protocols.

target_lang_translations.zh: 网络工程师最终淘汰了<w>Shiva智能隧道协议</w>，转而采用标准化的IPSec和TLS协议。

target_lang_definitions.zh: Shiva智能隧道协议；一种用于虚拟专用网（VPN）连接的专有计算机网络协议。

senses.sense_definition: Alternative form of <w>st</w>, used to urge silence or attract attention quietly; hush.

examples.text: "<w>Sst</w>! Keep your voice down or someone will hear us," whispered Daniel from behind the curtain.

target_lang_translations.zh: “<w>嘘</w>！小声点，不然有人会听到我们的，”丹尼尔在窗帘后低声说道。

examples.text: "<w>Sst</w>! Listen carefully to that noise coming from the hallway," she cautioned her companion.

target_lang_translations.zh: “<w>嘘</w>！仔细听走廊里传来的那个声音，”她提醒身边的同伴。

traits.comment: Used primarily in older literature as an interjection to enjoin silence.

target_lang_definitions.zh: st的变体，用于要求安静或悄悄吸引注意力；嘘。
